notes.title: Update 0.4.4
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Alice voices added
[*] The cursor has become more visible.
[*] Added a description of the buttons in the training
[*] At the end of the training, the overlapping information window was removed.
[*] Changed NPC behaviors a bit
[*] The chance of medication dropping out in survival mode has increased.
[*] Now you can see all controls
[*] Increased run speed.
[*] Changed background music in Stalker mode.
[/ list]

[h1]What to expect in the next updates?[/h1]

We made a pretty serious decision, and with the next update, the entire control and shooting system will be redone.

After that we will do a complete rework of the survival system “Stalker”, we will add a construction system and a goal will appear that needs to be achieved. And only after that we will introduce a new weapon.

[b]Your opinion is important to us and we try to listen to it! Thanks to everyone who supports us![/b]

notes.title: Update 0.4.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Adjusted light position from flashlight
[*] Medicines now restores 100 HP. immediately 30 and 5 times a second
[*] Fixed bug with incorrect display of cartridges.
[*] The chance of dropping drugs in the boxes has increased
[*] When starting in the "Stalker" mode, in addition to the pistol, the cartridges lay in the box
[*] Game map reduced now
[*] Fixed a bug when there was no pause when capturing a point.
[*] Added Arabic translation  (Thanks for the translation [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCLHKflgYOsa8jgKUM_oXMDQ]Hani[/url])
[*] In the "Stalker" mode, the inventory is now closed with a cro
[*]Rollback time dropped from 25 seconds to 10
[*]In stalker mode, the game will start at dawn.
[/list]
